purpose: The generic openings a pitch or a morning draft must not sound like: the obvious list the Reader Check's score guard reads each draft's opening against, in shadow only. Invented and generic; no person, show or company.
openers: I hope this email finds you well.
I hope you are keeping well.
I came across your profile and was really impressed by your work.
I wanted to reach out and introduce myself.
I am reaching out because I think there could be a great fit here.
I know you are busy, so I will keep this short.
I have been following your work for a while now.
I would love to pick your brain about something.
Just wanted to touch base and see how things are going.
I am writing to see if you would be open to a quick call.
Your show would be a perfect fit for our guest.
I think your audience would love to hear this story.
